name: AI Result Poisoning
summary: Adversaries may manipulate publicly accessible web content to influence generative AI systems or AI-powered search engines into retrieving, citing, or recommending attacker-controlled information. Unlike traditional SEO Poisoning, which primarily attempts to influence the ordering of conventional search results, AI Result Poisoning targets systems that synthesize information from multiple sources and provide a direct answer to the user.…

analytics.name: Analytic 2068
analytics.guidance: No target-side behavioral analytic. A defender cannot reliably distinguish an adversary intentionally staging public content to manipulate future AI retrieval from ordinary publishing, SEO, inaccurate information, duplicated content, or legitimate coordinated publication using target-enterprise telemetry.
